messages.author: 715287d64ddcb0b1
messages.subject: new paleontology paper using stan
parts:
Hi List,

Not to toot my own horn too hard, but I recently published a paper using stan. Another for the growing list.

http://www.pnas.org/content/early/2015/09/29/1510482112.abstract

Peter D. Smits. Expected time-invariant effects of biological traits on mammal species duration. PNAS 2015 ; published ahead of print October 5, 2015, doi:10.1073/pnas.1510482112.

Cheers,

Peter

Thanks --- we can add another -ology to the growing list.
I put it up on our web site. I really need to reformat that
all to read like citations. In retrospect, the BibTeX was
not a good choice.

- Bob
